## Issues

Put `Closes #N` on a line of its own for every issue this pull request finishes.
For partial work write `Refs #N` instead, and open a separate pull request to close it.
Never put an issue number you do not intend to close in the same sentence as `closes`:
GitHub closes every issue named in that sentence.
